notes.title: INTRODUCTION: SPECIAL ITEMS
notes.content:
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Introduction_Special_Items_Banner.jpg[/img]

Unveil the unique items in Icarus.  These items designed to empower its wielder to go beyond their limits in becoming a stronger.

[h3]EXP POTION[/h3]
The EXP Potion is one of the Special Item commonly use to boost your character’s experience growth.
Using this, you obtain 100% experience increase buff with a duration of 1 day. Recommended when grinding your level.
When consuming 1 EXP Potion, you are unable to use another item with the similar effect.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/E_potion_1Day.jpg[/img]

[h3]RESTORATION STONE[/h3]
This special item is called a Restoration Stone, and is one of the Special Item commonly use to repair a rider’s damage equipment. 
This allows players to restore the durability of any broken equipment due to over usage making it good as new. It is especially recommended for hunting and level grinding, as it allows players to avoid interruptions due to damaged equipment.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/R_Stone.jpg[/img]

These are just two of the many items available to elevate your efforts and maximize your progress. Each one is crafted to provide a significant boost, helping you advance further and achieve your goals more effectively.

notes.title: INTRODUCTION: MAP of Midellas Continent
notes.content:
[h1]MAP HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map1.jpg[/img]
Exploring the world of Icarus is a thrilling adventure, made even more captivating by its diverse and intricate landscapes. The game map is filled with highlights that beckon players to uncover hidden treasures, challenging dungeons, and wonderful sights.

[h2]BRACAR FOREST: BRAGGI BASE [/h2]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map2.jpg[/img]
Bracar Forest is one of the regions in Midellas Continent surrounded by mountains, greenfield, and forests. The area is home to creatures known as Braggi.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map3.jpg[/img]

The Braggi Base is the first zone a player will enter after finishing the tutorial. The quests is mainly to help the player to level up quicker. The NPCs that will give you tasks around includes:
[list]
[*] Crow
[*] White Smith
[*] Hannah
[*] Amelia Muller
[*] Lena
[*] Goddragon Knights Soldiers
[*] Injured Guard
[*] And more…
[/list]
There are other creatures living in the zone including:
[list]
[*] Rhino
[*] Green Leaf Io
[*] Wild Wolfs
[*] Fairies
[*] Bucky
[*] Wild Boar
[*] And more…
[/list]
There are also strong creatures reigning in this region:
[list]
[*] Kalimut
[*] Ahnturagen
[*] Dark Raiku
[/list] [img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map4.jpg[/img]

[h2]HARKANAS TERRITORY: RICH HILLS[/h2]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map5.jpg[/img]
Located in the heart of Harkanas Territory, is known for its abundant resources. This area is features rolling hills with sparkling streams, and vibrant flora.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/map6.jpg[/img]

Living alongside the humans in this area are creatures called Rabi. The locals in this region will undoubtedly assign tasks that require you to explore and appreciate the zone's beauty. 
[list]
[*] Princess Rania
[*] Long-fluffy-ear tribe chief
[*] Rabito
[*] King Cheshar
[*] Yulnus
[*] Elliot
[*] Russel
[*] Many more…
[/list]
Creatures living in the surround hills includes:
[list]
[*] Ent
[*] Monster Plant
[*] Vivaldi
[*] Rabbini
[*] Bees
[*] Poru
[*] Doom Hog
[*] Nero
[*] Many more…
[/list]
This region is also dominated by powerful creatures such as:
[list]
[*] Treebeard
[*] Eregos
[*] Hekanin
[/list]
There are so many places to visit in the Midellas continent that are a must-see. Each offering unique experiences that make exploring the region absolutely essential. With so many remarkable places to discover, it's a journey you won't want to miss.

notes.title: ICARUS M: GW INTRODUCTION: THE LORD GODS
notes.content:
Welcome to the world of Asbelia, where Icarus created the familiars who protects the land and it source of life. He created powerful familiars who he calls the Celestial Star. 
Familiars are integral part of the adventure. These mystical creatures will provide support to players in battle.

[h3][b]HELIOS[/b][/h3]

The Lord God Familiar of the Sun, is the spirit creature of fire.
Her fiery assault on the enemy inflicting de-buff that causes a burning sensation that weakens them. Her relentless attack makes the foe feel an intense, searing heat as they struggle under the effect of her powerful strike.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Helios_1.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount:[/b]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Helios_Mount_2.jpg[/img]
Watch her fiery essence of everlasting warmth:
[h3][previewyoutube=0lEpdaMclwk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/h3]

[h3][b]LIARA[/b][/h3]

The Familiar Lord God of Libra, is the spirit creature in charge of light.
She provides a wide range of support that relieves status effects, with an elemental de-buff resistance, and uses regenerative magic.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Liara_1.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount:[/b]
[h3][img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Liara_Mount.jpg[/img][/h3]

[h3][b]SELENE[/b][/h3]

The Lord God Familiar of the of Falling Flowers, is the spirit creature of poison.
A shaman that channels the mystical power of falling flowers that impose a poison upon the enemy, that endues continuous bleeding that weakens the enemy.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Selene_1.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount:[/b]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Selene_Mount.jpg[/img]
Watch her blooms upon the realm: 
[h3][previewyoutube=BDknXNVeKUM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/h3]

[h3][b]HERMES[/b][/h3]

The Lord God of Greek Mythology, is a spirit creature of light.
Using his Whirlwind skill generates a knock-back effect that pushes the enemies away while simultaneously reducing their defense. As the Lord God of Wisdom, he uses his God’s Blessings to provide buffs and healings to his allies.

[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Hermes_02.jpg[/img]
[b]Mount:[/b]
[img]https://file.valofe.com/Valofe_file/ph_op/Hermes_Mount.jpg[/img]
Watch as he soars above the sky of Icarus:
[h3][previewyoutube=gJPf2W7qYdU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/h3]

[h3]They are the few Lord God Familiars that will bestow power to players. These allies not only enhance your battle prowess but also unlock new strategic possibilities. 

There are countless Familiars to meet that will make your quest for collecting them an ever-exciting and rewarding endeavor.[/h3]

[h2]PLAY NOW![/h2]
